name: Salesforce - Beta
description:
The Salesforce MCP Server lets your teams securely access Customer 360 data and Salesforce capabilities without leaving the chat — all while honoring Salesforce security, permissions, and governance. Knowledge workers ask about pipeline, summarize cases, create campaigns, draft updates, and reason across accounts, opportunities, and more — grounded in real Salesforce data. Builders can use the Salesforce MCP server to configure and customize Salesforce to move their teams faster than ever. 

The Salesforce Headless 360 MCP Server is a Beta Service. Read our Developer Documentation to learn more: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/hosted-mcp-servers/guide/headless-360-mcp.html

_published_faq.name: How do I add Salesforce - Beta to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Salesforce - Beta to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.salesforce.com/platform/mcp/v1/platform/headless-360. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Salesforce - Beta MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Salesforce - Beta provides these MCP tools: describe, discover, dispatch, and dispatch_readonly.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Salesforce - Beta?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Salesforce - Beta in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Salesforce - Beta MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Salesforce - Beta requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Salesforce - Beta is developed by Salesforce. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
